seo.title: Guesthouse Website Design South Africa | Front Door Sites
seo.description: Websites and booking tools for South African guesthouses and B&Bs. Bring in direct bookings and keep the 15–18% commission booking sites charge. Websites from {websitesFrom}.

hero.h1: A guesthouse website that brings in direct bookings
hero.lead: Booking sites take roughly 15–18% commission on every booking. When guests book through your own website, that money stays with you.

argument.heading: Every direct booking keeps the commission in your pocket
paragraphs: Booking sites are good at sending you new guests, but you pay commission on every booking they send.

Guests often find you on a booking site, then look you up on Google before they book. Returning guests and referrals do the same. If they find your own website with your rooms, rates and a 'Book direct' button, they can book there instead.
You don't have to leave the booking sites. Keep them for new guests, and let your website catch everyone who's already looking for you.
points: Rooms, rates and photos that make guests want to stay

Live availability from NightsBridge or your booking system
Your Google Business Profile set up properly, so you show up on Maps

faq.q: Does it work with NightsBridge?
faq.a: Yes. On a bookings website I connect your NightsBridge booking button and live availability, so guests can check dates and book without leaving your site. Using a different booking system? Tell me which one. Most have a booking link or widget I can connect.

faq.q: Do I have to stop using Booking.com or Airbnb?
faq.a: No. Keep your listings for new guests. Your website gives returning guests, referrals and Google searchers a direct way to book, without the commission.

faq.q: I don't have a booking system. Can I still take bookings?
faq.a: Yes. A business site lets guests send an enquiry through a form or on WhatsApp, and you confirm the booking yourself, the way you do now.

faq.q: What's a digital guest info book?
faq.a: A simple page guests open on their phone, with the Wi-Fi password, check-in and check-out times, house rules and your local tips. You can change it any time, and you print less.

seo.title: Questions: Prices, Quotes, Care Plans & More | Front Door Sites
seo.description: Answers about Front Door Sites websites and business tools: prices, the free mock-up and plan, paying, owning your site, care plans and build times.

faqPage.lead: Straight answers about prices, payment, ownership and care plans. Can't find your question? Ask me on WhatsApp.

faq.q: How much will it cost?
faq.a: Websites from {websitesFrom} and business tools from {toolsFrom}. Tell me what you need and I'll send a fixed quote. The price only changes if you ask for something new, and I quote that first.

faq.q: What's the free mock-up?
faq.a: A sample of your website, built from your public info, like your Google Maps listing or Facebook page. It's free and there's no obligation.

faq.q: What's the free plan?
faq.a: For business tools: a short written plan of what the tool will do, the main screens, the price and how long it will take. It's free and there's no obligation.

faq.q: How do I pay?
a: {deposit} deposit to start, and the other {balance} when you approve it, before it goes live.

a.text: Care plans are paid by EFT each month, using the bank details on your invoice.

faq.q: Do I own it?
faq.a: Yes. Once it's paid in full, the website or tool is yours, and your domain is registered in your name.

faq.q: Do I have to take a care plan?
faq.a: No. Without one, I hand over the files so you can host it anywhere. Every website needs hosting somewhere, and a care plan is the easy way to have it handled.

faq.q: Can I cancel my care plan?
faq.a: Yes, with {noticeDays} days' notice. There's no minimum term.

faq.q: Can I pay for a care plan yearly?
faq.a: Yes. Pay for a year upfront and you get 12 months for the price of {yearlyPaysMonths}. For example, the Care plan costs {careYearly} a year.

faq.q: What's a small edit?
faq.a: A text, price, photo or hours change. Bigger changes are quoted, from {extraWorkFrom}.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: It depends on the size of the job, and your quote includes a timeline.

faq.q: Do I need to get on a call?
faq.a: No. Everything happens on WhatsApp and email. Voice notes are welcome.

faq.q: Will it work on phones?
faq.a: Yes. Websites and tools are built for phones first, then checked on computers.

faq.q: What can a business tool do for me?
faq.a: It takes a job you do by hand and makes it quicker. For example:
list: A builder could send a neat quote from a phone in two minutes, then turn it into an invoice.
A salon could keep every client's colour formulas and notes in one place, instead of on paper cards.
A farm stall could take orders for collection without fifty WhatsApp messages.
A transport company could see every job, driver and delivery on one screen.

faq.q: Are there other costs?
faq.a: Things like booking software, payment fees or SMS sending are paid by you, and I list them in your quote. Hosting is covered by a care plan, or you can host it yourself.
